ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 55% low-intensity (black) pixels at margins and center versus 45% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels in central lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity contiguous patches located in the medial sections of the left and right lobes, surrounded by a thick, low-intensity (black) border. The high-intensity zones are intersected by numerous low-intensity linear and mottled pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations between 5-15 pixels along the entire boundary; includes a significant irregular indentation/notch on the distal portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep from the peduncle transition, leading to a jagged horizontal trajectory towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles/scars) detected at the far left distal tip and centrally on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense detection of unaligned, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral patches, with high concentrations on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic indentation/loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe; visible orange-toned parasitic or barnacle clusters on the extreme lateral margins.
